decisions.reason: The Magento template is a low-cost option with unresolved market potential and complements existing e-commerce services.
The responsive template faces generic competition but costs little to keep, so the option remains open while uncertainty persists.
Premium support involves ongoing resource commitments, but its early results are still too uncertain to justify abandoning the option.
The version management tool is a larger commitment outside the core business, yet its dedicated page indicates enough investment to warrant further evaluation before dropping.
The data processing contract tool addresses a clear regulatory need under GDPR, making it a valuable option with little reason to drop.
